scripts.translation: 怎么样？是不是很佩服我的学识？以后有问题随时来找我。

scripts.text: Tikbalangs have a way to confuse travelers when they meet them by making them turn in circles regardless of wherever and how far they travel.
scripts.translation: 邪魔马会用一种方法迷惑遇到的旅行者，让他们不管走多远、往哪个方向走，最后都只会原地打转。
它们是喜欢恶作剧的生物。

scripts.text: But of course there is a way to stop their pranks. You know about the Inside-out Shirt? You can either wear your top inside-out.
scripts.translation: 当然，有办法阻止它们恶作剧。你知道反穿的衬衫吗？把上衣反着穿就行。

scripts.text: Or go on your way quietly without disrupting the Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation: 或者别去惊扰邪魔马，安安静静地从旁边经过。

scripts.text: Ha ha ha ha~ But everyone knows adventurers are never quiet while they travel, right?
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈~不过大家都知道，冒险者赶路时从来不会安静，对吧？

scripts.text: They say Tikbalangs have several distinctions.
scripts.translation: 据说邪魔马有几个显著特征。

scripts.text: First, they are very tall ^AAAAAA(tsk... wish I were tall)^000000 and have skinny, imbalanced legs and arms. Looks almost like a human but their knees are higher than their upper body when they sit down.
scripts.translation: 首先，它们个子很高（啧......真希望我也这么高），手脚细长，比例失调。它们看起来几乎和人类一样，但坐下时，膝盖会高过上半身。 ^AAAAAA^000000

scripts.text: Second, is the standard characteristics acknowledged by the association. They have heads and feet like a horse.
scripts.translation: 其次，是协会公认的标准特征：它们长着马头和马蹄。

scripts.text: So with all these appearance traits, Tikbalang is sometimes called the creature from hell.
scripts.translation: 综合这些外貌特征，邪魔马有时也被称为地狱来的生物。

scripts.text: There are several fun rumors about Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation: 关于邪魔马，还有几个有趣的传闻。

scripts.text: One of them is about Tikbalangs being the guardians of some kingdom that worships nature.
scripts.translation: 其中一个传闻说，邪魔马是某个崇拜自然的王国的守护者。

scripts.text: So the Tikbalangs will trick travelers who come with bad intentions to the kingdom by making them travel in circles.
scripts.translation: 因此，邪魔马会让怀着恶意前往那个王国的旅行者原地打转，以此戏弄他们。

scripts.text: Another rumor is that people around here say that 'if it rains on a clear day, then it must be Tikbalang's wedding day'.
scripts.translation: 另一个传闻是，当地人常说：“大晴天突然下雨，就是邪魔马结婚的日子。”

scripts.text: The association speculates that sayings like 'it rains on Bathory's wedding day' or 'it rains on Moonlight Flower's wedding day' might have derived from the Tikbalang's saying.
scripts.translation: 协会推测，“巴托里结婚那天会下雨”或“月夜猫结婚那天会下雨”这类说法，可能源自关于邪魔马的谚语。

scripts.text: Lastly, ancient fairy tales say that Tikbalangs can transform into human form or even make themselves transparen't but nobody has verified this yet.
scripts.translation: 最后，古老的传说称邪魔马能变成人形，甚至能让自己隐形，不过至今还没有人证实。

scripts.text: Tikbalangs usually live in dark, busy places where there aren't many people around.
scripts.translation: 邪魔马通常住在阴暗、人烟稀少的地方。

scripts.text: Hmm... For example, they are known to live beneath bridges, in banana and bamboo forests and beneath large trees.
scripts.translation: 嗯......比如据说它们住在桥下、香蕉林和竹林里，或是大树底下。

scripts.text: And this is just my opinion but wouldn't you agree that they are living in dark places because it is easier to play pranks on people?
scripts.translation: 这只是我的个人看法，不过你不觉得它们住在阴暗处，是因为那里更方便捉弄人吗？

scripts.text: Ha ha ha. Do you now know how great I am?
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈。现在你知道我有多厉害了吧？

scripts.text: Oh! Isn't this material to make 'Tikbalang Belt' used to tame Tikbalangs?
scripts.translation: 哦！这不是制作驯服邪魔马用的“邪魔马腰带”的材料吗？

scripts.text: The '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' is used to capture Tikbalangs without the hassle. But that doesn't mean it's 100% successful. Interested? Do you want me to make one for you?
scripts.translation: “邪魔马腰带”能让捕捉邪魔马变得轻松，不过也不是百分之百成功。有兴趣吗？要我帮你做一条吗？ ^F80835^000000

scripts.text: No, I can capture one myself.
You? Ha... You can try if you want to.
scripts.translation: 你？哈......想试的话就去试试吧。

scripts.text: There is the easy way and the hard way to capture Tikbalangs. Which one do you prefer?
scripts.translation: 捕捉邪魔马有简单和困难两种方法。你想选哪一种？

scripts.text: Ha ha. I've come up with the easy way myself.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，简单的方法可是我自己想出来的。

scripts.text: Bring me 3 Tikbalang's Thick Spines and 5 Lesser Agimats to make a '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' to help you easily capture Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation: 带3根邪魔马的粗脊刺和5个小型护符来，我就能帮你制作“邪魔马腰带”，让你更轻松地捕捉邪魔马。 ^F80835^000000

scripts.text: It's 3 Tikbalang's Thick Spines and 5 Lesser Agimats. Understood?
scripts.translation: 是3根邪魔马的粗脊刺和5个小型护符。听懂了吗？

scripts.text: It's easy for me but I don't know about you.
scripts.translation: 对我来说很简单，不过你能不能做到就不好说了。

scripts.text: Tikbalangs have a sharp, pointy mane behind their neck.
scripts.translation: 邪魔马的后颈长着尖尖的鬃毛。

scripts.text: Of course! There are several of them but you must get the three thickest ones.
scripts.translation: 没错！它们有好几根鬃毛，但你得找出最粗的三根。

scripts.text: These three manes are the weak point. You can tame a Tikbalang by pulling the manes out.
scripts.translation: 这三根鬃毛就是它们的弱点。把鬃毛拔掉，就能驯服邪魔马。

scripts.text: Now let me explain how to pull these manes out.
scripts.translation: 现在我来告诉你怎么拔掉这些鬃毛。

scripts.text: You must fly like a butterfly and land like a bee on the back of a Tikbalang.
scripts.translation: 你得像蝴蝶般轻盈地飞起，再像蜜蜂一样落在邪魔马背上。

scripts.text: Of course! The Tikbalang will get mad and try to shake you off with all its might.
scripts.translation: 当然，邪魔马会勃然大怒，拼命想把你甩下来。

scripts.text: All you have to do is hold on until the Tikbalang gets exhausted.
scripts.translation: 你只要牢牢抓住，撑到邪魔马精疲力尽就行了。

scripts.text: Then again, itll take 4 days and 3 nights for Tikbalangs to get tired since they are strong creatures. But let's not focus on too much details.
scripts.translation: 不过，邪魔马体格强健，要让它们累倒得花上4天3夜。细节就不多说了。

scripts.text: Which means!! The Tikbalang is already tamed.
scripts.translation: 也就是说！！邪魔马就被驯服了。

scripts.text: I will upgrade your armor if you bring one that holds enormous power.
scripts.translation: 只要你带来蕴藏强大力量的装备，我就能帮你升级。

scripts.text: What kind of equipment do upgrade?
What will it become after an upgrade?
Your questions are too simple, but!
scripts.translation: 你问的问题虽然简单，不过！

scripts.text: ^7B4772Bakonawa Scale Armor^000000 made from the scales of the Bakonawa monster known to swallow the moon.
scripts.translation: 巴库暴龙鳞甲，由以吞月闻名的魔物巴库纳瓦的鳞片制成。 ^7B4772^000000

scripts.text: Light but sturdy ^7B4772Kalasag^000000 made from rattan that grows wild around Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 卡拉沙格盾轻便又结实，由马来港周边野生的藤条编成。 ^7B4772^000000

scripts.text: ^7B4772Buwaya Sack Cloth^000000 made from the sack of the man-eating alligator Buwaya.
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄囊布，由食人鳄魔物宝箱巨鳄的囊袋制成。 ^7B4772^000000

scripts.text: ^7B4772Bangungot Boots of Nightmare^000000 imbued with the hatred and vengeance of the monster Bangungot.
scripts.translation: 噩梦般滚勾特长靴，蕴含着魔物般滚勾特的怨恨与复仇之力。 ^7B4772^000000

scripts.text: I will make powerful armor out of ONLY the strongest armor dropped from fearful monsters.
scripts.translation: 我只会用可怕魔物掉落的顶级装备，打造强力护甲。

scripts.text: Seems you learned that there is no such thing as free in life.
scripts.translation: 。看来你明白了，这世上没有免费的午餐。

scripts.text: First thing to remember is that the object to upgrade must be strong itself. At least strong enough to endure ^FF0000+9 Refinement^000000.
scripts.translation: 首先要记住，待升级的装备本身必须足够强。至少要能承受+9精炼。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Next is true strength that only comes out of power obtained naturally. I need ^FF000020 Ancient Grudges^000000 for protection from evil while Im refining.
scripts.translation: 其次，装备必须蕴含自然获得的真正力量。精炼时我需要20个远古怨灵来抵御邪恶。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: When a ^FF0000+9 Refined Strong armor^000000 is combined with ^FF000020 Ancient Grudges^000000 for protection!!
scripts.translation: 把+9精炼的强力护甲和用于驱邪的20个远古怨灵结合起来！！ ^FF0000^000000^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: You get a completely new and improved armor from old scraps.
scripts.translation: 就能用旧装备打造出全新强化的护甲。

scripts.text: Listen, because this is a very important question.
scripts.translation: 听好了，这是个非常重要的问题。

scripts.text: It won't matter if I say it more than a 100 times that upgraded armor is powerful.
scripts.translation: 不管我说多少遍，升级后的护甲有多强都说不完。

scripts.text: Unless the one that holds it doesn't believe it is! Ask about what has changed and decide for yourself!
scripts.translation: 不过，若是装备的人自己都不相信它很强，那也没用！问问升级后有哪些变化，再亲自判断吧！

scripts.text: Looks like you ran out of questions.
scripts.translation: 看来你没什么要问的了

scripts.text: Don't forget. You'll have to give up something to gain something.
scripts.translation: 。别忘了，想要得到，就得有所付出。

scripts.text: The Bakonawa Scale Armor adds +1 to all stats for all jobs which is overall great armor for everyone.
scripts.translation: 巴库暴龙鳞甲能为所有职业的全部能力值各加1，是人人都适用的好护甲。

scripts.text: But I'm sure the inner you thinks this isn't enough.
scripts.translation: 不过我猜你心里肯定觉得这还不够。

scripts.text: That is why +2 can be added to all stats and an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation: 所以升级后，所有能力值还能再加2，并且可以增加一个卡片插槽。

scripts.text: Kalasag is a good shield to reduce damage from boss monsters by 1% per 3 refinements.
scripts.translation: 卡拉沙格盾是面不错的盾牌，每精炼+3，受到首领魔物的伤害就减少1%。

scripts.text: But not enough. Can't believe that a shield doesnt have a place to equip a card.
scripts.translation: 不过这还不够。盾牌居然不能插卡，实在让人难以置信。

scripts.text: That is why I can add an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation: 所以升级后，我可以为它增加一个卡片插槽。

scripts.text: The Buwaya Sack Cloth offers healing capacity and healing item effect increase by 1% per 3 refinements. Not to mention it reduces 10% damage from Water, Earth, Fire, and Wind elemental monsters.
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄囊布每精炼+3，治疗效果和恢复类道具效果就提高1%。此外，受到水、地、火、风属性魔物的伤害还会减少10%。

scripts.text: But not enough. Can't believe that these clothes don't come with a place to equip a card. Everyone knows that clothes should have Raydric on them!
scripts.translation: 不过这还不够。衣服居然不能插卡，真让人难以置信。谁不知道衣服就该插幽灵剑士卡片！

scripts.text: Don't worry! I can add an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation: 别担心！升级后我可以为它增加一个卡片插槽。

scripts.text: The Bangungot Boots of Nightmare increases +1 MDEF per 1 refinement and speed increases starting at 14 refinement and above.
scripts.translation: 噩梦般滚勾特长靴每精炼+1，魔法防御力就提高1；精炼达到+14后，还会提升移动速度。

scripts.text: The speed increase effect from shoes like Moonlight Flower Shoes and Sleipnir items are out of reach for ordinary people.
scripts.translation: 月夜猫之靴或史雷普尼尔这类鞋子的加速效果，普通人可望不可及。

scripts.text: But of course, +14 refinement isn't easy but there is an easy way to get it.
scripts.translation: 当然，精炼到+14并不容易，不过有个简单办法。

scripts.text: By upgrading your shoes, you can get speed increase starting from +12 refinement!
scripts.translation: 升级鞋子后，精炼达到+12就能获得加速效果！

scripts.text: I will also put in an extra slot in your socket to add a card.
scripts.translation: ！我还会额外增加一个卡片插槽。

scripts.text: However, you'll have to give up something to gain something.
scripts.translation: 不过，想要得到某些东西，就得有所舍弃。

scripts.translation: 如果同时装备卡拉沙格盾、宝箱巨鳄囊布、巴库暴龙鳞甲和噩梦般滚勾特长靴，就会失去套装效果。 ^0000FF^FF0000^0000FF^000000
想清楚了再回答。下一个问题呢？

scripts.text: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Good!
I will need an light but sturdy armor with an refinement of +9 or greater and 20 Ancient Grudges!!
scripts.translation: ！我需要一件精炼+9或以上、轻便又结实的护甲，还要20个远古怨念！！

scripts.text: You said all preparations are done and you give me this?! I need at least 20 Ancient Grudges to refine your item.
scripts.translation: 你说准备好了，结果就拿这个给我？！精炼你的装备至少需要20个远古怨念。

scripts.text: So what armor will it be?
scripts.translation: 那么，你要升级哪件装备？

scripts.text: You should wear the equipment to upgrade and not come without it on you.
scripts.translation: 要升级的装备得穿在身上，别空手过来。

scripts.text: What is this! You said you wanted to upgrade {0} but why are you giving me this? You should be wearing {1}.
scripts.translation: 这是怎么回事！你说要升级{0}，怎么把这个拿给我？你应该穿着{1}才对。

scripts.text: No, the sturdiness of this item has not been tested yet. It'll have to be at least +9 refined for me to say, 'Oh this is pretty sturdy armor.
scripts.translation: 不行，这件装备的坚固程度还没经过考验。至少精炼到+9，我才能说：“这护甲确实够结实。”

scripts.text: Looks like you did your homework! Don't see a flaw! Then I have one question to ask before I start refinement.
scripts.translation: 看来你做足了功课！我没发现任何问题。那么开始精炼前，我还有个问题要问。

scripts.text: ^0000FFOnce your item is refined, the refinement level will be ^FF00000^0000FF and the item will be upgraded.^000000 You get this part?
scripts.translation: 装备精炼后，精炼等级会变为0，装备也会得到升级。这点明白了吗？ ^0000FF^FF0000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: What? You didn't know this? Then, read through my instructions and come back again.
scripts.translation: 什么？你不知道吗？那就先把我的说明读一遍，再回来吧。

scripts.text: Good. Next question. Once refinement is done,
scripts.translation: 很好。下一个问题。精炼完成后，

scripts.text: ^0000FFEquipping the Kalasag, Buwaya Sack Cloth, Bakonawa Scale Armor, and Bangungot Boots of Nightmare all at once will lose the ^FF0000Set Effects^0000FF.^000000
scripts.translation: 000FF同时装备卡拉沙格盾、宝箱巨鳄囊布、巴库暴龙鳞甲和噩梦般滚勾特长靴，会失去套装效果。 ^0000FF^FF0000^0000FF^000000

scripts.text: What? You didn't know this? Then, read through my instructions and come back again.
scripts.translation: 什么？你不知道吗？那就先把我的说明读一遍，再回来吧。
太好了！那我们开始精炼{0}吧。

scripts.text: Congratulations. Your armor is better than ever.
- From the wary looks on the guard's face, it is obvious he is at alert at the sight of you. He won't intimidate you but seems he won't even deal with you either. -
scripts.translation: - 卫兵警惕地盯着你，显然已经戒备起来。他虽然没有出言威胁，却也不打算搭理你。 -

scripts.text: - Would there be anyone to talk to in the village? -
scripts.translation: - 村子里会有人愿意跟我说话吗？ -

scripts.text: There is a small area called ^3131FFBaryo Mahiwaga^000000 outside of Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 马来港外有个叫巴里奥·马希瓦加 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: The place is closer to mother nature than what we have here.
scripts.translation: 00的小地方。那里比这里更亲近大自然。

scripts.text: On the other hand, the area is full of fierce monsters. Take care of yourself while you're traveling there.
scripts.translation: 不过，那一带凶猛的魔物很多。去的时候小心点。

scripts.text: There are more people leaving the village secretly these days. Are you also heading for the woods to look for the mysterious treasure?
scripts.translation: 最近偷偷离开村子的村民越来越多。你也要去森林里找那件神秘宝物吗？

scripts.text: I take that back. On second thought, I don't think a weakling like you would even dare to go there.
scripts.translation: 算了。我看你这么弱，恐怕连去那里的胆子都没有。

scripts.text: You'd better hold tight to your mommy's hand if you want to go outside of Port Malaya or else the monsters will eat you alive. Ha ha.
scripts.translation: 想离开马来港的话，最好紧紧牵着你妈妈的手，不然魔物会把你活活吃掉。哈哈。

scripts.text: Is that why there are more outsiders here these days? Now don't be sneaky and a know-it-all. How would you know if I'd offered to take you around?
scripts.translation: 最近外来者变多，是因为这个吗？别偷偷摸摸地装出一副什么都懂的样子。你怎么知道我会不会带你到处逛逛？

scripts.text: Oh, so you aren't here to look for treasure?
scripts.translation: 哦，所以你不是来找宝物的？

scripts.text: I hear people are talking about a mysterious treasure hidden deep in the woods.
scripts.translation: 我听说大家都在传，森林深处藏着一件神秘宝物。

scripts.text: Do you see that group of people over there? They always gather and talk about it every day.
scripts.translation: 看到那边那群人了吗？他们每天都聚在一起聊这件事。你也

scripts.text: Try talking to them if you are interested, too.
scripts.translation: 感兴趣的话，就去问问他们吧。

scripts.text: So the talk about treasure was just a rumor? I'm not asking because I want to be rich overnight. Ha ha.
scripts.translation: 原来宝藏的传闻只是谣言啊？我才不是想一夜暴富才问的呢。哈哈。

scripts.text: - Look at you warily while whispering to each other. -
scripts.translation: - 他们一边警惕地看着你，一边低声交谈。 -

scripts.text: No, I heard they got lost in the woods.
scripts.translation: 没有，我听说他们是在森林里迷路

scripts.text: Who would hide such a treasure from a small village like ours?
scripts.translation: 了。我们这种小村子附近，谁会藏那么贵重的宝物？

scripts.text: Could it been a monster? My grandma said there is a dragon with a huge head living deep inside the woods.
scripts.translation: 会不会是魔物干的？我奶奶说，森林深处住着一条大头龙。

scripts.text: You all know ^3131FFTotoy^000000? The kid living at the ^3131FFInn^000000.
scripts.translation: 你们都认识托托伊吧？就是住在旅馆 ^3131FF^000000^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Well, did you know Totoy came back from the woods recently?
scripts.translation: 00000的那个孩子。你们知道吗？托托伊最近从森林里回来了。
真的？！他居然活着回来了？

scripts.text: Yeah. But the strange part is that the troublemaker ^3131FFTotoy^000000 now quietly stays home and never comes out.
scripts.translation: 是啊。可奇怪的是，那个捣蛋鬼托托伊现在乖乖待在家里，再也不出门了。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Don't you get it? Totoy must have found the treasure.
scripts.translation: 你们还不明白吗？托托伊一定是找到宝物了。
什么？！那托托伊现在岂不是发财了？ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: I saw ^3131FFTotoy^000000 come back home, but Totoy wasn't carrying anything.
scripts.translation: 我看见托托伊回家时，手里什么 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: But then, I must have missed it because I ran back home right away.
scripts.translation: 也没拿。不过也可能是我没留意，我当时急着跑回家了。

scripts.text: Then what is ^3131FFTotoy^000000 doing at home?
scripts.translation: 那托托伊待在家里做什么？ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: I think Totoy is making a plan to bring the treasure back without us knowing it.
scripts.translation: 我看托托伊是在盘算怎么瞒着我们把宝物运回来。那个

scripts.text: To have the whole treasure for himself, that greedy kid.
scripts.translation: 贪心的孩子，想把整批宝物都据为己有。

scripts.text: The treasure would be in better hands with me ~
scripts.translation: 把宝物交给我保管才好呢~

scripts.text: I would clean it every day so it shined and would use it as a beautiful ornament. Ah~~~
scripts.translation: 我会天天把它擦得闪闪发亮，当成漂亮的摆设。啊~~~

scripts.text: Then how about we talk to ^3131FFTotoy^000000 to spill the beans on where the treasure is?
scripts.translation: 那我们去问问托托伊，让他把宝物藏在哪儿说出来吧？ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Wow. That is an awesome idea. No wonder you're the leader!
scripts.translation: 哇，这主意真棒。不愧是你，领头人！

scripts.text: But will ^3131FFTotoy^000000 give up the information easily?
Because Totoy was sneaky enough to think of getting away with taking the whole treasure.
scripts.translation: 会乖乖告诉我们吗？他既然能想到独吞所有宝物，肯定狡猾得很。

scripts.text: Then we should convince ^3131FFTotoy^000000 to tell us where the treasure is instead of looking for it ourselves.
scripts.translation: 与其自己去找，不如先说服托托伊，让他告诉我们宝物在哪儿。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Ah~~~ it is so hard to get something pretty these days ~~~!!!!
scripts.translation: 啊~~~现在想弄到漂亮东西可真难啊~~~！！！！

scripts.text: - Better pay a visit to this Totoy to get more information about the treasure. -
scripts.translation: - 最好去找托托伊问问宝物的事。 -

scripts.text: - People are talking with serious faces. -
scripts.translation: - 人们正神情严肃地交谈。 -

scripts.text: - See someone shaky with dopey eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 你看到一个人浑身发抖，眼神呆滞。 -

scripts.text: - See someone shaky with dopey eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 你看到一个人浑身发抖，眼神呆滞。 -

scripts.text: Wah! No! Go away! Leave me alone!
Huh... you're a person? Who are you?
- He looks you straight in the face but doesn't seem to recognize you. -
scripts.translation: - 他直视着你的脸，却似乎认不出你。 -

scripts.text: I am {0}. You are Totoy, right? People say you've found a treasure. Is it true?
scripts.translation: 我是{0}。你是托托伊，对吧？听说你发现了宝藏，是真的吗？

scripts.text: I can't see. I'm blinded. Please help me. I'm tired and frustrated.
scripts.translation: 我看不见了，我瞎了。求你帮帮我。我又累又烦......

scripts.text: Can't talk long. I need to heal my eyes first.
scripts.translation: 我没法跟你聊太久，得先治好眼睛。

scripts.text: There should be some ^3131FFGreen Potion^000000 left inside the drawer. Will you take it out for me?
scripts.translation: 抽屉里应该还剩下一瓶绿色药水。能帮我拿出来吗？ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Can't talk long. I need to heal my eyes first.
scripts.translation: 我没法跟你聊太久，得先治好眼睛。

scripts.text: There should be some ^3131FFGreen Potion^000000 left inside the drawer. Will you get it for me?
scripts.translation: 抽屉里应该还剩下一瓶绿色药水。能帮我拿来吗？ ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Hello? Hey, are you still there? What happened to the Green Potion? Jeez, this is driving me crazy.
scripts.translation: 喂？你还在吗？绿色药水呢？真是的，快把我急死了。

scripts.text: Do not hand over the potion.
Did you really leave? Hey! Darn!
I can see!! My eyes work!!!
scripts.translation: 我看得见了！！眼睛能看见了

scripts.text: Wow! You look better than you sounded. Ha ha.
scripts.translation: 哇！你本人看起来比声音听起来精神多了。哈哈。

scripts.text: But what did you say? Something about a treasure?
scripts.translation: 对了，你刚才说什么来着？宝藏？

scripts.text: Did you say I found a treasure?
Tell him what the people are talking about.
scripts.translation: 告诉他村民们在议论什么

scripts.text: Puhaha! Totoy is rich! Became rich overnight! Chief Ed!
scripts.translation: ？！噗哈哈！托托伊发财啦！一夜暴富！首领艾德！

scripts.text: Sorry but I went to the woods to collect bugs. Wish I saw a treasure while I was at it. Hmph!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我是去树林里抓虫子的。要是顺便发现宝藏就好了。哼！

scripts.text: I did go deep in the woods because I wasn't getting anywhere with collecting bugs. But who would have thought I'd get into this mess?
scripts.translation: 我确实去了树林深处，因为一直抓不到虫子。可谁想到会惹上这种麻烦？

scripts.text: I only wanted to show people my collection of cute bugs. Ha ha.
scripts.translation: 我只是想给大家看看我收集的可爱虫子。哈哈。

scripts.text: Dropping ice or bugs down peoples clothes is just like a daily greeting, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 把冰块或虫子塞进别人衣服里，不就像每天打招呼一样吗？

scripts.text: I love to see people run around the village like they are in a marathon. He he.
scripts.translation: 我最喜欢看大家像参加马拉松似的在村里乱跑了。嘿嘿。

scripts.text: I thought people wouldn't run away because of an ordinary bug so I went in the woods with Ed.
scripts.translation: 我以为大家不会被一只普通虫子吓跑，所以就和艾德一起进了森林。

scripts.text: Ah, Ed is my cute puppy. He's very nice and cuddly. My best friend in the whole wide world.
scripts.translation: 啊，艾德是我可爱的小狗。它又乖又黏人，是全世界最好的朋友。

scripts.text: Ed usually barks a lot but I should have looked around when he barked and pulled on my sleeves.
scripts.translation: 艾德平时很爱叫，但它冲我叫、扯我袖子时，我真该看看周围的。

scripts.text: - Totoy bends over and whispers to you as if walls have ears. -
scripts.translation: - 托托伊弯下腰，凑近你耳边低声说，仿佛隔墙有耳。 -

scripts.text: There was a monster with a mouth the size of a house right behind me.
scripts.translation: 我身后有只魔物，嘴巴大得像一栋房子。

scripts.text: Shssh! Be quiet. I've never seen a mouth that big before. It was full of a river of saliva flowing out of spiky teeth. Just the thought of it makes me want to hide.
scripts.translation: 嘘！小声点。我从没见过那么大的嘴，满口尖牙，还淌着一大股口水。光是想想我就想躲起来。

scripts.text: The scariest part is that the monster has two heads. You won't believe it till you see it.
scripts.translation: 最可怕的是，那只魔物有两个脑袋。你不亲眼看见肯定不会相信。

scripts.text: Ed bit the monsters leg with all his might to let me get away. But I don't know what happened to him afterwards. Sniff~
scripts.translation: 艾德拼尽全力咬住魔物的腿，好让我逃走。可我不知道后来它怎么样了。呜......

scripts.text: That's when I hurt my eye. To tell you the truth I don't even remember how I came back.
scripts.translation: 我就是那时伤了眼睛。说真的，我连自己怎么回来的都不记得了。

scripts.text: Don't know. It was the first time I saw a monster like that. Who could live to tell the story?
scripts.translation: 不知道。我也是第一次见到那种魔物。谁能活着回来讲清楚呢？

scripts.text: Wait, maybe the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000 might know about the monster. They say he fought with all sorts of monsters.
scripts.translation: 等等，也许狩猎大师知道那是什么魔物。据说他跟各种魔物都交过手。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I need some time alone. I need to make a tombstone for Ed. If you want to meet the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000, you'll find him near the Weapon Store.
scripts.translation: 我想一个人静一静。我得给艾德立块墓碑。你要是想见狩猎大师，去武器店附近找他。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: And tell everyone else to stop spreading rumors about treasure. They don't know what I went through. Sniff! I'm going to put Ancient Worms in everyones clothes!
scripts.translation: 还有，告诉大家别再传什么宝藏的谣言了。他们根本不知道我经历了什么。呜......我要把狂暴蜈蚣塞进每个人的衣服里！

scripts.text: I have to make a grave for Ed. My loyal friend, Ed...
scripts.translation: 我得给艾德立个墓碑。艾德，我忠实的朋友..

scripts.text: If you want to meet the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000, you'll find him near the Weapon Store.
scripts.translation: ....想见狩猎大师的话，就去武器店附近找他。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Can't believe you gave your life to save me. Wail!!!
scripts.translation: ！真不敢相信你为了救我牺牲了自己。呜啊啊！！

scripts.text: - Totoy can't be lying when he's crying his heart out like this. -
scripts.translation: - 托托伊哭得这么伤心，应该不可能是在撒谎。 -
我看到那只魔物的地方？

scripts.text: I was so busy running away...
It was really deep in the woods. Probably even past Baryo Mahiwaga.
scripts.translation: 是在森林很深的地方，可能比巴里奥·马希瓦加还要深入。

scripts.text: I think I heard the sound of ^3131FFFlowing Water^000000. A large whooshing sound. This is all I remember.
scripts.translation: 我好像听到了流水声，还有很大的轰鸣声。我只记得这些。 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Poor Ed. I miss Ed. Wail!!!!
scripts.translation: 可怜的艾德。我好想你。呜啊啊！！

scripts.text: Poor Ed. I miss Ed. Wail!!!!
scripts.translation: 可怜的艾德。我好想你。呜啊啊！！

scripts.text: You've come back!!! I'm so happy!!!!
You didn't see the monster, did you?
scripts.translation: 你了！你没碰上那只魔物吧？

scripts.text: The monster is called Buwaya. I told the Guard about the monster. You better not go near the place again.
scripts.translation: 那只魔物叫宝箱巨鳄。我已经把它的事告诉卫兵了。你最好别再靠近那里。

scripts.text: He he. Ed, the woods are too dangerous so we can't go there for bugs anymore.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，艾德，森林太危险了，我们以后不能再去那里抓虫子了。

scripts.text: But I'm sure we can find a way to keep our reputation with other creepy stuff!
scripts.translation: 不过我相信，我们一定能找到别的吓人玩意儿，保住咱们的名声！

scripts.text: Anyway, thanks for bringing my best friend back.
scripts.translation: 总之，谢谢你把我最好的朋友带回来。

scripts.text: I don't have much but would like to thank you. Wait, let me see what's inside my drawer. He he-
scripts.translation: 我没什么值钱的东西，不过还是想谢谢你。等等，让我看看抽屉里有什么。嘿嘿——

scripts.text: - You have too many items on you. -
- Totoy goes through the drawer, turning it upside down. Making a mess of the room. -
scripts.translation: - 托托伊翻遍抽屉，把里面的东西全倒了出来，房间顿时一团乱。 -

scripts.text: Here. My mom gave it to me but I don't know how to use it... He he.
scripts.translation: 给你。这是妈妈送我的，可我不知道怎么用......嘿嘿

scripts.text: I hope you can use it.
Visit me when you get bored!
scripts.translation: 无聊的时候就来找我玩

scripts.text: Just don't ask about the treasure again~!
scripts.translation: 吧！不过别再问宝藏的事了~！

scripts.text: Ed went out to play so I'm alone.
scripts.translation: 艾德出去玩了，现在就我一个

scripts.text: Would there be something awesome to surprise people with?
scripts.translation: 人在家。有没有什么好玩的东西能吓大家一跳呢？

scripts.text: - You look for the Green Potion in Totoys drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 你在托托伊的抽屉里找绿色药水。 -

scripts.text: What? I only see an empty potion bottle.
Does this mean I have to get the potion myself? That Totoy is really a troublemaker.
scripts.translation: 看来我得自己去找药水了？托托伊真会给人添麻烦。

scripts.text: I am the Master of Hunting! I'm not afraid of anything with just one exception! I'm afraid of outsiders...
scripts.translation: 呵！我就是狩猎大师！什么都吓不倒我，只有一样例外！我怕外来者......

scripts.text: I went all the way to Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to defeat the Angry Minorous.
scripts.translation: 呵！我一路跑到卢恩-米德加兹王国，打倒了愤怒的米洛斯。

scripts.text: And I succeeded in killing Muka, the one with the voice of a demon that disturbs the peace of the world.
scripts.translation: 我还成功杀死了摩卡——那个用恶魔般的叫声扰乱世界安宁的家伙。

scripts.text: Wow! He was really tough. I'm starting to sweat just thinking of him.
scripts.translation: 哇，它可真难对付。光是想想我都冒汗了。

scripts.text: Yo! You look like you have a few battle stories yourself. Have you ever seen a Minorous? Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation: 哟！看起来你也有不少战斗故事嘛。见过米洛斯吗？哈哈哈！

scripts.text: So you came here to learn all about my excellent hunting skills? Or to ask me to publish an essay on Master of Hunting? Ho!
scripts.translation: 你是来学习我高超的狩猎技巧，还是想让我发表一篇《狩猎大师》？呵！

scripts.text: Oh? Hey! Where are you going?!
You say someone saw the monster?
scripts.translation: 你说有人见过那只魔物？

scripts.text: There are many monsters in and out of Port Malaya. What is so special about this one?
scripts.translation: 马来港里里外外有那么多魔物，这一只有什么特别之处？

scripts.text: About a monster with two heads
Ho! A monster with two heads, you say? Are you kidding? Where on earth is there a monster with two heads?!
scripts.translation: 呵！你说有双头魔物？开玩笑吧？这世上哪有双头魔物？！

scripts.text: The kid must have been scared by a Condor or something.
scripts.translation: 那孩子肯定是被秃鹰之类的吓着了

scripts.text: There's a saying that someone surprised to see a Permeter, will also be surprised to see a peach tree. Ha ha!
scripts.translation: 。俗话说，有人看见果树龟会大吃一惊，看见桃树也会一样。哈哈！

scripts.text: You shouldn't lie to an adult. I understand you want the Master of Huntings attention. Ha ha!
scripts.translation: 别对大人撒谎。我知道你是想引起狩猎大师的注意。哈哈！

scripts.text: Kids tell stories for their own reasons. I'm sure Totoy is the same.
scripts.translation: 孩子们讲故事都有自己的理由。我看托托伊也一样。

scripts.text: Oh! Really? Bring proof if you really think the kid is telling the truth.
scripts.translation: 哦？真的吗？你要是觉得那孩子说的是真的，就拿证据来。

scripts.text: Every living thing leaves some kind of trace behind. You also leave behind traces and scents wherever you go. Especially in private places, I mean. He he!
scripts.translation: 所有生物都会留下痕迹。你走到哪里也会留下痕迹和气味，尤其是在比较私密的地方。嘿嘿！

scripts.text: Try collecting 10 Animal Samples from where the kid saw the monster. I will look for traces of that monster from the samples.
scripts.translation: 去那孩子遇见魔物的地方收集10份动物样本吧。我会从样本里找出那只魔物留下的痕迹。

scripts.text: Let's see if we have a monster in it!
I don't think there is a monster.
It was a kid's joke. Ha ha.
scripts.translation: 原来只是小孩子的恶作剧。哈哈。

scripts.text: Oh! Really? Bring proof if you really think the kid is telling the truth.
scripts.translation: 哦？真的吗？你要是觉得那孩子说的是真的，就拿证据来。

scripts.text: Every living thing leaves some kind of trace behind. You also leave behind traces and scents wherever you go. Especially in private places, I mean. He he!
scripts.translation: 所有生物都会留下某种痕迹。你走到哪里，也会留下痕迹和气味。尤其是在比较私密的地方，我是说。嘿嘿！

scripts.text: Try collecting 10 Animal Samples from where the kid saw the monster. I will look for traces of that monster from the samples.
scripts.translation: 去那孩子遇见魔物的地方收集10份动物样本吧。我会从样本里找出那只魔物留下的痕迹。

scripts.text: Bring me back samples if you want to prove there is a monster with two heads.
scripts.translation: 想证明有双头魔物的话，就把样本带回来给我。

scripts.text: You've really brought back the samples.
scripts.translation: 了。你居然真的把样本带

scripts.text: Ho! Leave it there and come back after washing your hands. Even god won't smile down at you with that stench.
scripts.translation: 回来了。嘿！先放在那里，洗完手再回来。这么臭，连神明都不会保佑你。

scripts.text: You! Come here and feel this!
Don't just stand there. Touch the sample!
Hurry and tell the Guard Leader that Buwaya is active again. Hurry! You'll find the Guard Leader at the north of the village.
scripts.translation: 快去告诉卫队长，宝箱巨鳄又开始活动了。快！卫队长就在村子北边。

scripts.text: - Felt something pointy with the end of your fingers. -
scripts.translation: - 指尖摸到了一个尖锐的东西。 -

scripts.text: Ho! This is huge! And so dense that it can easily scratch steel!
scripts.translation: 嘿！这东西好大！而且硬得惊人，轻易就能刮伤钢铁！

scripts.text: Ah! Yes! Stop holding it up. It stinks. Go wash your hands.
scripts.translation: 啊，对！别把它举着了，太臭了。快去洗手。

scripts.text: Hmm. The monster the kid saw must be Buwaya. No doubt about it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，那孩子遇到的魔物一定是宝箱巨鳄，绝对没错。

scripts.text: I've heard that the wife of the neighbor of my grandfather's uncle on my mom's side was also killed by Buwaya.
scripts.translation: 我听说我母亲那边、我祖父的叔叔的邻居的妻子，也是被宝箱巨鳄杀死的。

scripts.text: They say no living thing is left after Buwaya passes by.
scripts.translation: 据说宝箱巨鳄所到之处，生灵涂炭。托

scripts.text: Totoy is one lucky kid. Wow!
Buwaya was inactive for a long time. Wonder if it was hibernating? Hmm.
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄已经很久没活动了。难道是在冬眠？嗯......

scripts.text: Now that I know that a monster like that is out there, I should be cautious, too.
scripts.translation: 既然知道还有这种魔物出没，我也得提高警惕

scripts.text: Must tell the villagers not to go too deep into the woods.
scripts.translation: 。得提醒村民别往森林深处去。

scripts.text: Please go and tell the Guard Leader that Buwaya is active again.
scripts.translation: 请去告诉卫队长，宝箱巨鳄又开始活动

scripts.text: I will contact other hunters in the meantime and think of a plan to kill Buwaya.
scripts.translation: 了。我会联系其他猎人，一起想办法除掉它。

scripts.text: - You have too many items on you. -
- You don't have to collect any more samples. -
- You see something entangled with soil and grass. -
scripts.translation: - 你看到一个缠着泥土和草叶的东西。 -

scripts.text: - You are nauseous by the foul smell coming from the samples you are collecting. -
scripts.translation: - 收集来的样本散发出恶臭，熏得你一阵反胃。 -

scripts.text: - You slowing and cautiously collect the squashy and slightly warm substance. -
scripts.translation: - 你缓慢而小心地收集这种软乎乎、还带着些许温度的东西。 -

scripts.text: It's warm as a mother's bosom.
scripts.translation: 温暖得就像母亲的怀抱。

scripts.text: - You have too many items on you. -
- Look at you warily while whispering to each other. -
scripts.translation: - 他们一边警惕地看着你，一边低声交谈。 -

scripts.text: We are busy as hell because of Bangungots servants attacking the hospital.
scripts.translation: 噩梦死神般滚勾特的仆从正在袭击医院，我们忙得不可开交。

scripts.text: We are doing our best in securing the safety of our village so please enjoy your stay in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation: 我们正全力确保村子的安全，请安心在马来港逗留。

scripts.text: Buwaya? The merciless creature is back?
scripts.translation: 宝箱巨鳄？那个残暴的家伙又回来了吗？

scripts.text: That's bad news. We are already short-handed by assigning everyone to fight off Bangungot.
scripts.translation: 这可糟了。我们已经人手不足，所有人都派去抵挡噩梦死神般滚勾特了。

scripts.text: And villagers need to go to the woods to collect fruits and vegetables.
scripts.translation: 而且村民还得去森林里采集蔬果。

scripts.text: Hmm... will you be able to help Port Malaya?
scripts.translation: 嗯......你愿意帮帮马来港吗？

scripts.text: Really? That's no good. All the lives of the villagers will be at stake if we don't do something. How can a youth like you be so heartless. Are all outsiders like you? Hmph! Can't trust young people these days. Hmph.
scripts.translation: 真的吗？那可不行。我们要是不采取行动，村民的性命都会受到威胁。你年纪轻轻，怎么这么冷漠？外来者都像你这样吗？哼！现在的年轻人真不可靠。哼。

scripts.text: I knew I could count on you.
I need to know where Buwaya will likely appear in order to secure villagers living area.
scripts.translation: 。为了保护村民的住处，我得知道宝箱巨鳄可能会在哪里出没

scripts.text: Guess Buwayas nest will be the best bet.
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
scripts.translation: 到达那一带后，投掷烟雾弹 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation: 0000。我们会朝烟雾升起的地方赶去。

scripts.text: Then take care and good luck.
scripts.translation: 那就小心行事，祝你好运。

scripts.text: ^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
scripts.translation: 到达那一带后，投掷烟雾弹 ^3131FF^000000

scripts.text: Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation: 0000。我们会朝烟雾升起的地方赶去。

scripts.text: Let's first bring Ed to Totoy.
scripts.translation: 我们先把艾德带回托托伊身边吧。

scripts.text: The holy task of drawing Tattoos is only done during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'. Sorry but looks like the festival is not on.
scripts.translation: 纹身这项神圣仪式只会在“彩绘节”期间举行。抱歉，现在不是庆典期间。 ^7A96E0^000000

scripts.text: You've come right on time during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation: 你来得正是时候，现在正值“彩绘节”。 ^7A96E0^000000

scripts.text: There is no time like during the holy '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000' to draw Tattoos.
scripts.translation: 想纹身，没有比神圣的“彩绘节”期间更合适的时候了。 ^7A96E0^000000

scripts.text: The festival doesn't last long so I should start drawing. What Tattoo do you need?
scripts.translation: 庆典持续不了多久，我得开始纹身了。你想纹哪种？
祝你在“彩绘节”玩得开心。 ^7A96E0^000000

scripts.text: I think you are short on materials.
scripts.translation: 看来材料不够。需要10个远古

scripts.text: Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of {0}'s Spirit, and 1 {1} Doll to create a ^EE1D11{2} Agimat Tattoo^000000.
scripts.translation: 怨念、1块灵魂碎片和1个玩偶，才能制作护符纹身。 {0}{1}^EE1D11{2}^000000

scripts.text: The materials are full with holy energy. I'm sure we'll get a great Tattoo using these.
scripts.translation: 这些材料蕴含着神圣的力量。用它们一定能纹出很棒的图案。

scripts.text: Please don't interrupt while I'm working on drawing a holy Tattoo if you want it to come out right.
scripts.translation: 想让神圣纹身顺利完成，在我工作时就别打扰我。

scripts.text: The Tattooist placed the Ancient Grudges around the workplace.
scripts.translation: 纹身师把远古怨念摆放在工作台周围。

scripts.text: The Ancient Grudge lit up and tools starts to glow. He smiled satisfyingly at the glowing tools and materials.
scripts.translation: 远古怨念发出光芒，工具也开始闪耀。纹身师满意地看着发光的工具与材料。

scripts.text: And then {0} stared intensely at the doll as if to remember every detail of it in his head.
scripts.translation: 接着，{0}紧盯着玩偶，仿佛要把每个细节都牢牢记住。

scripts.text: Oh no, now you ruined it.
I cannot draw a Tattoo for someone like you who doesn't understand art. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation: 式毁了。我可不会给不懂艺术的人纹身。剩下的材料你拿回去吧。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5个远古怨念、个玩偶，以及的灵魂碎片。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: Think he will melt the doll with his eyes?
scripts.translation: 他是想用眼神把玩偶融化吗？

scripts.text: He closed and opened his eyes slowly as if to memorize the doll in his head and then held up a glowing tool to start drawing.
scripts.translation: 他慢慢闭上又睁开眼，仿佛要把玩偶的模样记在脑海里，随后举起发光的工具开始绘制。

scripts.text: The {0} Tattoo was completed almost instantly.
But he kept on looking at each corner of the drawing as if he didn't like some of its details.
scripts.translation: 但他仍盯着图案的各个角落，似乎对某些细节不太满意。

scripts.text: Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
The Tattooist ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 纹身师恼怒地撕碎了画稿。

scripts.text: I can't continue like this. Maybe another time. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation: 这样我没法继续。改天再来吧。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5个远古怨念、个玩偶，以及的灵魂碎片。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: He looked at the drawing intensely for a long time and then nodded with a satisfied smile.
scripts.translation: 他凝视着画稿许久，最后满意地点了点头。

scripts.text: Looks like he is satisfied with the {0} drawing.
scripts.translation: 看来他对{0}的图案很满意。

scripts.text: But now he is staring at the sky without doing anything else. What is he waiting for?
scripts.translation: 可现在他只是仰望天空，什么也不做。他在等什么？

scripts.text: Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
The Tattooist ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 纹身师恼怒地撕碎了画稿。

scripts.text: I can't continue like this. Maybe another time. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation: 这样我没法继续。改天再来吧。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 取回了5个远古怨念、个玩偶，以及的灵魂碎片。 {0}{1}

scripts.text: The Tattooist's eyes started to shine after staring at the sky for awhile, then he broke the Piece of {0}'s Spirit with both his hands.
scripts.translation: 纹身师仰望天空片刻，双眼开始发亮，随后用双手捏碎了{0}的灵魂碎片。

scripts.text: The Piece of {0}'s Spirit is shattered into powder. The Tattooist's hands are glowing.
scripts.translation: {0}的灵魂碎片化成粉末，纹身师的双手开始发光。

scripts.text: Why did you break the pieces...
scripts.translation: 你为什么要把碎片捏碎......

scripts.text: Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
The glowing light from his hands faded away. He starred at his hands for a while and then ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 他手上的光芒渐渐消退。他盯着自己的手看了一会儿，随后恼怒地撕碎了画稿。

scripts.text: I was this close to completing a wonderful piece but you ruined it. Not in a good mood. You can take the remaining materials.
scripts.translation: 我差一点就能完成杰作了，结果被你毁了。我现在心情很差。剩下的材料你拿回去吧。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges and the doll.
scripts.translation: 取回了5个远古怨念和那个玩偶。

scripts.text: He held up the powder in both hands and then blew it onto the drawing.
scripts.translation: 他双手捧起粉末，吹向画稿。

scripts.text: All Ancient Grudges started to burn and then the glowing light from the {0} drawing faded away.
scripts.translation: 所有远古怨念都燃烧起来，随后{0}图案上的光芒渐渐消退。

scripts.text: Blinking light on top of the drawing.
Light faded away and the {0} drawing is no longer the simple one it was before.
scripts.translation: 光芒渐渐消退，{0}的图案不再像之前那样简单。

scripts.text: The {0} drawing looks as if it is... alive.
scripts.translation: {0}的图案看起来……仿佛活了过来。

scripts.text: The Tattooist is finally satisfied and is all smiles.
scripts.translation: 纹身师终于满意了，笑容满面。

scripts.text: Ha ha. It came out great.
I'm sorry you had to wait for a long time. But it was worth it cause I haven't created a Tattoo of this quality in a long time.
scripts.translation: 抱歉让你等了这么久，不过一切都值得。我已经很久没做出品质这么好的纹身了。

scripts.text: The ^EE1D11{0} Agimat Tattoo^000000 you've waited for is now completed.
scripts.translation: 你等候已久的^EE1D11{0}护符纹身^000000终于完成了。
祝你在“彩绘节”玩得开心。 ^7A96E0^000000

scripts.text: I came from afar and dropped everything to come and enjoy the 'Pintados Festival'.
scripts.translation: 我从远方赶来，放下手头的一切，就是为了参加“彩绘节”。

scripts.text: I don't like the Tattoo I got after all I've gone through to get it.
scripts.translation: 费了这么大劲才弄到的纹身，我其实并不喜欢。

scripts.text: I've looked at it in the light but I think the Tattooist made a mistake.
scripts.translation: 我对着光仔细看过了，觉得纹身师肯定弄错了。

scripts.text: I heard of the 'Pintados Festival' and came all the way from Kunlun.
scripts.translation: 我听说有“彩绘节”，特地从昆仑赶来。

scripts.text: Just in case you might think otherwise, this is a mask on my face and not a tattoo.
scripts.translation: 先说清楚，我脸上戴的是面具，不是纹身。

scripts.text: Hey, hear me. This isn't the Tattoo I wanted.
scripts.translation: 喂，听我说，这根本不是我想要的纹身。

scripts.text: I asked for a Bakonawa Tattoo but the more I look at it, this is Bangungot.
scripts.translation: 我明明要的是巴库暴龙纹身，越看越觉得这像般滚勾特。

scripts.text: No... you said that you wanted that one. Don't be so difficult.
scripts.translation: 不是......明明是你说要这个的。别这么难缠。

scripts.text: Don't you know that customer is king? Huh? Do you want a bad reputation?
scripts.translation: 你不知道顾客就是上帝吗？嗯？想落得个坏名声吗？

scripts.text: Ah... I can't work with customers like this.
scripts.translation: 唉......这种客人我实在应付不了。

scripts.text: How many times do I have to tell you, you said you wanted a Bangungot.
scripts.translation: 我都说多少遍了，是你自己说要纹般滚勾特。

scripts.text: Ouch, my throat... Shouting will get me nowhere.
scripts.translation: 嘶......嗓子好痛......光喊也解决不了问题。

scripts.text: They say the Pintados Festival will only be held for one week.
scripts.translation: 听说 彩绘节只举办一周。

scripts.text: I came from Luoyang without knowing about the festival. Must be my lucky day.
scripts.translation: 我从洛阳来，之前不知道有庆典。看来今天真走运。

scripts.text: The Pintados Festival wouldn't be a festival without a drummer.
scripts.translation: 没有鼓手，彩绘节就不成其为庆典了。

scripts.text: The Pintados from Pintados Festival means painted in our language.
scripts.translation: 在我们的语言里，Pintados 的意思是“绘上图案”。

scripts.text: So that is probably why we have people drawing special Tattoos during the festival.
scripts.translation: 所以庆典期间大家会纹上特别的图案，大概就是因为这个吧。

scripts.text: I don't remember it accurately, but they say the Pintados Festival was to celebrate a rich harvest.
scripts.translation: 我记不太清了，不过据说 彩绘节是为了庆祝丰收。

scripts.text: I always get energetic when I hear drums and sticks in a rhythmic beat.
scripts.translation: 每当听见鼓棒敲出有节奏的鼓点，我就浑身来劲。
咚—哒—嚓—咚—哒—嚓—真有意思！

scripts.text: I may be using sticks to catch the beat right now but you never know if I'll grow big enough to play the drums, right?
scripts.translation: 我现在虽然只能用鼓棒打节奏，但说不定长大后就能真正打鼓了呢，对吧？
